<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''VS黒いレックウザ''' ''VS Black Rayquaza'') is the third chapter of the {{OBP|Anime Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Adventure|manga}} manga. It was first published in the May 2024 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]]'', released on April 15, 2024. It is based on the ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' episode ''[[HZ045|From So Far Away]]''.
